content.short: Statrys is a Hong Kong multi-currency business account and payments platform with company setup services.
content.description: Statrys is a Hong Kong-based payments company offering multi-currency business accounts to companies and entrepreneurs trading internationally, with a focus on Asia. Its account supports holding and transacting in around a dozen major currencies, dedicated account details, competitive foreign exchange, SWIFT and local payments, and physical and virtual cards, managed through an online platform with human support. Statrys also provides company incorporation and corporate services in Hong Kong and Singapore, making it convenient for foreign founders to set up and bank a business in one place. Targeting SMEs, e-commerce sellers and international entrepreneurs, it works as a practical alternative to traditional Hong Kong bank accounts.
content.meta: Statrys offers multi-currency business accounts and company setup from Hong Kong. Discover Statrys and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
